Subject: Quick ask — per-1M token rates (input/output) + supported models

Hi Hannah,

We are kicking off a shortlisting exercise for an LLM inference partner. Can you send over your standard per-1M token baseline rates (please split input vs output) for the hosted API and a short list of supported/production-ready model families?

A few constraints:
- US region only for now
- We expect a pilot at ~15M tokens/month initially, with potential to scale to 500M+/month in 12 months
- Important for procurement: how you define input vs output, rounding/granularity, and whether embeddings are priced separately

I've attached a short MVP requirements doc so you can see our expected call patterns. Also please flag any minimum commitments needed for the rates.

Thanks — Sasha
Sasha Patel
VP of AI Platforms, Gladius AI
attachments: gladius_mvp_requirements.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 14:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — per-1M token rates (input/output) + supported models

Hi Sasha — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the requirements doc; I skimmed it and this looks like a typical pilot profile. Below is a concise baseline to get started. I'll loop Ben (sales) for committed discount details and Jonas (solutions) if you want an infra runbook.

Baseline hosted API — per 1M tokens (input / output):
- rdb-small (1–4B families): $6.00 / $18.00 per 1M tokens
- rdb-large (6–9B families): $9.00 / $27.00 per 1M tokens
- rdb-chat-7b (chat-optimized): $12.00 / $36.00 per 1M tokens
- rdb-34b-quant (high-quality, quantized): $28.00 / $84.00 per 1M tokens

Notes:
- Input vs output: we bill tokens consumed in request input separately from tokens generated in response output. The prices above are split as input / output.
- Granularity: we meter at the request level and aggregate per billing period; token accounting is exact (no 1k-token rounding), but invoices report in 1M token buckets for readability.
- Embeddings: charged separately — $0.90 per 1M input tokens for embedding generation (flat rate) or $0.0009 per vector for higher-dim vectors (let us know the vector size).
- Region: the rates above are for the US-hosted tier (standard tenancy). Dedicated/private options and additional security/compliance add-ons have different pricing.

I've attached a sample rate sheet (CSV) and a one-pager that summarizes the baseline and common commit discounts. If you'd like, Ben can propose a 90-day pilot commercial that reduces the effective output rate for heavy generations.

Next steps: could you confirm estimated monthly tokens for the pilot and whether you need SOC 2/contracting in place before we start?

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
attachments: sample_rate_sheet_q2-2025.csv, redwood_token_pricing_onepager.pdf

Subject: Re: Quick ask — per-1M token rates (input/output) + supported models

Hi Sasha — Ben here from Sales. Quick follow-up with commercial-level detail so procurement has talking points.

Committed discount lanes (hosted API, US region):
- No commit / self-serve: list rates as Hannah shared
- Pilot commit (3 months, 50M total tokens): 7% off list on output charges
- Mid commit (12 months, 500M total tokens): 15% off list on output + 5% on input
- Enterprise (annual, negotiated >2B tokens): custom pricing, typically 20–30% off list with performance SLAs and priority capacity

Billing and rounding: tokens are counted exactly per request; we aggregate hourly and invoice monthly. We do not round up to the next 1K tokens per request. For very spiky traffic we can offer pre-batched token credits that smooth billing if you prefer predictable invoices.

Embeddings & other units: embeddings are priced separately (see Hannah's line). We can also offer a bundled package that includes 50M embed vectors + 100M generation tokens as a pilot SKU if you want a single PO.

Contracting: we typically require an MSA + SOW for multi-month pilots above $25k. SOC 2 Type II and penetration test reports available under NDA.

Happy to jump on a 20–30 minute call to align on the pilot economics and get a draft PO/DocuSign over to you. When would you like to schedule?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
